name: uLPARSurf
description: light at top of local layer

name: aLPARBot
description: light at bottom of local layer

name: uhL (case 1)
description: half-saturation light intensity at current temperature (Chalker 1980)

name: aLLim (case 1)
original_formula: aLLim= 1.0_rk /(extc * dz) * log((1.0_rk + uLPARSurf / uhL) / (1.0_rk + aLPARBot /uhL))
code_implementation: aLLim= 1.0_rk /(extc * dz) * log((1.0_rk + uLPARSurf / uhL) / (1.0_rk + aLPARBot /uhL))

name: uOpt (case 2)
description: optimal light intensity at current temperature (Klepper 1988)

name: aLLim (case 2)
original_formula: aLLim = exp(1.0_rk) /(extc * dz) *(exp(- aLPARBot /uOpt) - exp(- uLPARSurf /uOpt))
code_implementation: aLLim = exp(1.0_rk) /(extc * dz) *(exp(- aLPARBot /uOpt) - exp(- uLPARSurf /uOpt))

name: aMuTmL
description: max growth rate dictated by light and temp

name: aPLim
original_formula: aPLim = max(0.0_rk,(1.0_rk - self%cPDMin / rPDW) * self%cPDMax /(self%cPDMax - self%cPDMin))
code_implementation: aPLim = max(0.0_rk,(1.0_rk - self%cPDMin / rPDW) * self%cPDMax /(self%cPDMax - self%cPDMin))

name: aNLim
original_formula: aNLim = max(0.0_rk,(1.0_rk - self%cNDMin / rNDW) * self%cNDMax /(self%cNDMax - self%cNDMin))
